title: Relocate G3 (env-preflight) + G3.5 (codex-update-preflight) into flywheel-local-launcher
description:
Part of the relocation wave that MUST land before the delete pass. rework-PLAN.md 3.2 and 9 flag this as the plan's most likely real failure: guards get deleted but never rehomed, so the knowledge is simply lost.

WHY THESE TWO MOVE: both are preflight checks that already RUN inside the launcher. The conductor's Step 1 does nothing but delegate to 'flywheel-link.sh preflight'. Documenting them in the conductor puts the rule in a different file from the code that enforces it.

G3 env-preflight — the rule to preserve: deployment-level env vars are not settable by anonymous worker agents, and process-only env does not satisfy deployment validation. Self-generated secrets (signing keys) can be generated and set without the user; platform-issued keys must be surfaced to the user, parking only the affected chain. Journal the variable NAME only, never the value. Also: some CLIs let process env silently override an explicit target flag (CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY overrode Convex --prod and caused a worker to read non-prod data while claiming prod facts, customer-kingfield 2026-07-05), so preflight must check variables that change deployment IDENTITY, not just variables the application code reads.

G3.5 codex-update-preflight — the rule to preserve: Codex self-update is interactive and process-replacing. If it fires inside freshly spawned worker panes, the update completes and exits both panes cleanly; respawn then recreates shells rather than Codex workers and the swarm starts at 0/N. Preflight must probe Codex currency BEFORE any spawn and refuse to proceed until the probe is clean. Evidence: skills dogfood 2026-07-02, Codex 0.142.4 to 0.142.5 interactive update emptied both panes.

SCOPE — files you own: skills/engineering/flywheel-local-launcher/** only. Do NOT edit skills/engineering/flywheel-conductor/** (another bead deletes from there) and do NOT edit prompts/**.

G4 one-shot-only — the rule to preserve: never run watch/dev modes or start a persistent dev server; the agent's turn hangs forever because those processes never exit. Use one-shot equivalents ('convex dev --once', test runners without watch, playwright with a line reporter); e2e uses Playwright webServer with reuseExistingServer so the server boots and tears down inside the run. Evidence: AT session, all three workers hung 11m+ on watch commands.

G5 exact-tooling — the rule to preserve: when a worker knows a tool exists but not its interface, it burns tokens scanning the filesystem instead of asking. The kickoff prompt must hand over exact interfaces verbatim: Agent Mail is MCP tools or the local mail HTTP endpoint on port 8765; beads is 'br --db <path>'. title: G7 recovery hollow: ntm respawn does not relaunch codex — escalate to kill+fresh-spawn
description:
G7 recovery is hollow: ntm respawn does NOT relaunch codex. PROVEN 2026-07-02: (1) live certify — "G7 detected on pane 1 -> respawning" fired 7x, closed stuck at 1/3, TIMEOUT; (2) direct test — `ntm respawn skills --panes=1 --force` on a RUNNING idle codex pane dropped it to a bare shell with no codex relaunch. ntm respawn uses `tmux respawn-pane -k`, which kills the agent but leaves a shell. certify then `ntm send --cod`s the prompt into a shell (no codex listening), so the pane stays dead and G7 re-fires until timeout. Detection (nme.14) and closed-bead counting (nme.15) are now PROVEN correct — only recovery is broken.

PROVEN-WORKING recovery: `ntm kill <session>` + fresh `ntm spawn <session> --cod=N --init-prompt ...` relaunches codex cleanly; the worker resumes via `br ready` (shared tree + beads make this safe). There is no reliable per-pane relaunch via ntm today.

FIX (worker):
1. conductor-certify.sh G7 handler: after ONE respawn attempt that does not restore the pane (G7 still present on the next poll), ESCALATE to `ntm kill "$session"` + fresh `ntm spawn "$session" --cod=1 --init-prompt "$init_prompt"`; then continue the drive loop (remaining beads still open, worker resumes). Cap escalations (e.g. 1 respawn + 1 kill/respawn) to avoid infinite loops; on exhaustion, fail with a clear message. g7_recovered=true only once closed advances past the pre-kill count.
2. guards.md G7: rewrite the Fix to state ntm respawn alone leaves a bare shell and does NOT relaunch the agent; the reliable recovery is session-level kill+fresh-spawn (note the multi-worker cost; workers resume from br ready), and reference G10 for any in_progress bead left by the killed worker.
3. commands.md respawn recipe + flywheel-local-launcher flywheel-kickoff.sh readiness note: correct the "respawn then re-send prompt" guidance accordingly (respawn does not relaunch; use kill+fresh-spawn).

PROOF: a green `conductor-certify.sh --repo <dir> --yes` run (detection + WORKING recovery + epic reaches 3/3). Reserve conductor-certify.sh, references/guards.md, references/commands.md, and flywheel-local-launcher/scripts/flywheel-kickoff.sh via Agent Mail before editing.

- durable constraint / tradeoff -> fine as-is

- present-truth claim -> must be measurable/checkable, or reframe it
Ban only the unmeasurable present-truth assertion.
